prompt: What do we call to a document that explains a concept?
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 most directly answers the question by naming a common term (“white paper”) for a document that explains a concept, and it briefly adds other plausible alternatives. Candidate 2 answers with “concept document/concept paper,” but it narrows the interpretation toward project-proposal-style documents and spends more time on contents than on the naming question. Candidate 3 largely reframes into a comparison of concept documents vs. technical reports rather than directly answering what to call such a document. Candidate 4 is off-topic, discussing the role of diagrams rather than naming a document type.
